# Bertil Tandayamo

> Forward Deployed Engineer based in Cayambe, Ecuador (UTC−5). Builds web products, MVPs, dashboards and integrations with Next.js, React, Node.js and TypeScript, plus smart-contract work (Solidity, Polygon) when a product needs it. Building production web apps since 2020. Languages: English (advanced), Spanish (native).
